Lee (Support): FYI urgent escalation for HarborTech — onboarding stuck. Their embedding upload is failing; they need prod cutover next Tue and QA is blocked.

Lee (Support): Error snippet:
```
HTTP 502 when POST /v1/embeddings
{ "error": "kv_cache_miss: shard_timeout" }
```

Lee (Support): They've hit this ~12x in the last 2 hours. Marked Sev2. Requesting CS to own comms and renewal risk assessment. @Maya (CS) @Raj (AE) pls. :warning:

Maya (CS): On it. Can you paste the customer_id and exact workspace? I'll pull the onboarding playbook and schedule a touchpoint. :eyes:

Lee (Support): customer_id: HT-7723, workspace: harbor-prod. Reproducer we used:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d @payload.json`

Maya (CS): Thanks. @Taylor (Solutions Eng) can you try a quick config tweak (batch size / model fallback) to avoid the kv timeout? If not, we'll prep a call with their infra and discuss Dedicated pool as mitigation.

Taylor (Solutions Eng): Trying low-risk change now: force single-request batching + quantized fallback. Quick runbook: 1) set REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX=1 2) model=fallback/quantized-1.2 3) monitor for 30m. I can also collect kv stats if it fails again.

Raj (AE): Heads up — renewal in 6w with SLA credit clause. If they see outages before cutover, churn risk increases. I'll draft a comms template once we confirm impact. :grimacing:

Maya (CS): Draft comms plan (working):
- immediate ack + ETA from Support
- technical call w/ SE within 4 hours
- daily status updates until resolved
- proposed mitigations and potential SLA/credit options if needed
I'll loop Legal for escalation approvals. @Raj please reserve a 30m exec touchpoint for Wed. :calendar:

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260305-894. Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-runtime.

Lee (Support): Quick update — after REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX=1 the reproducer succeeded once, then failed again after ~10 calls. Logs show kv eviction on long prefix keys. SE requested kv cache dump.

Taylor (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. I'll pull kv metrics (hit/miss sizes, eviction rate) and share a short run of `redis-cli --stat` + runtime counters. If eviction is root cause we can bump cache or route this workspace to a Dedicated pool temporarily.

Maya (CS): Action items consolidated: - SE deep-dive (Taylor) - Exec touch (Raj) - Comms template (Maya) - Monitor + escalate to Dedicated if unstable by EOD. I'll schedule a 13:00 sync and invite HT stakeholders.

Raj (AE): Exec slot booked Wed 14:00 PST. I added legal and the renewal owner to the invite.

Maya (CS): Sending initial acknowledgment to HT now and will update after SE findings. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
